## Session Brief

* [I-C1: the cut_decays window rule, and the exemption guard over the exempting pairing](I-C1.md) - With cut_decays = F, exempt per point the pairing whose forced lines are inside the window (closest to the pole if several), restate refuse_ir_unsafe_exemption over that pairing and every massless gauge-charged leg, and gate σ against local MadGraph.
* [I-C2: refuse every massless splitting that no cut regulates](I-C2.md) - Extend #109's photon–parton guard to every massless-pair collinear or soft limit (q → q g, g → g g, ℓ → ℓ γ, partons outside the jet classes) that no pT, pair or xqcut cut regulates, with a refusal test per class and every banked card still accepted.
* [I-R1: the absent-run-card defaults follow create_default_for_process; an untabulated parton is refused](I-R1.md) - Reproduce every field banner.py's create_default_for_process changes for a scattering process (MLM matching on mixed jet multiplicities, lepton, e p, neutrino and EVA beams) in RunCard::scattering_default, and refuse any initial-state parton the PDF does not tabulate.
* [I-R2: refuse a zero τ floor, honour mxx_only_part_antipart, end the run on a worker panic](I-R2.md) - Three small refusal and robustness fixes: a card with no ŝ floor is refused before any point, mxx_only_part_antipart's keys enter the per-PDG cuts as in MadGraph (or it is refused off default), and a rayon worker panic ends the CLI promptly with its message.
* [I-S1: bound each peripheral rung by the thresholds of the legs it can reach](I-S1.md) - Cuts::spacelike_floor caps every peripheral rung at the largest single-leg pT_min²; derive a provable bound per rung from its adjacent legs (or fall back to the smallest threshold), and gate p p > a j j at pta 40, ptj 0.1, draj 0.4 against the CERN host's MadGraph.
* [I-Z1: release tooling for v0.2.0: version tags only, rc tags as prereleases, committed release notes, the version bump](I-Z1.md) - build.rs describes only v* tags; release.yml publishes hyphenated tags as prereleases and reads the notes from a committed file, failing without it; the workspace moves to 0.2.0; all proven by a manual release.yml run with no tag pushed.

## Session Report

* [I-C1 report: the cut_decays window rule is not IR-safe on the every-pairing |M|²](I-C1-report.md) - Stopped before code: an exempt identical quark can go collinear with a beam while its pair stays on the pole, and the other pairings give |M|² ∝ 1/pT² (probe: |M|²·pT² constant to 1e-4; no pole for z > d d~). Led to D2.
* [I-C2 report: refuse every uncut massless soft or collinear limit](I-C2-report.md) - Final-collinear, initial-collinear and soft limits that no compiled cut regulates are refused; all 62 seeded rows accepted under the equivalent-photon exemption; a pole probe shows pp_to_epemjj_qcd0 diverges at tree level (D1: refuse it).
* [I-R1 report: the default run card follows create_default_for_process; an untabulated beam parton is refused](I-R1-report.md) - With no run card, vibegraph builds MadGraph's written default card (MLM on mixed jet multiplicities, lepton beams, sde_strategy, beams refused by name); σ on p p > e+ e- + j matches MadGraph to +0.006%; untabulated partons are a typed refusal.
* [I-R2 report: zero τ floor refusal, mxx_only_part_antipart, worker-panic exit](I-R2-report.md) - ZeroTauFloor refuses a card with no ŝ floor before any point (MadGraph integrates it behind an implicit √ŝ ≥ 2 GeV); mxx_only_part_antipart's keys join pdg_cut with light codes refused; a worker panic exits 101 at once.
* [I-Z1 report: release tooling for v0.2.0](I-Z1-report.md) - build.rs describes v* tags only; hyphenated tags publish as prereleases; notes come from docs/release-notes/<tag without suffix>.md and a missing, empty or TODO file fails; workspace 0.2.0; a release.yml dispatch ran green with publish skipped.
